---
title: "IPCEI DiD --- Intensity (total collaboration), unmatched eligible pool"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(did)
library(dplyr)
source("_cs_helpers.R")
set.seed(42)
BSTRAP <- TRUE    # clustered multiplier bootstrap for the final robustness run
```

No-matching robustness for the intensity outcome (total collaboration). Treated
firms plus all structurally eligible controls; confounding handled by C&S
doubly-robust covariate adjustment (`xformla`). Two variants per technology:
**DR** (with covariates) and **Raw** (no covariates, to expose selection).
Mirrors `06_..._psm.Rmd`; outputs to `results/unmatched/intensity/`.

The eligible pool is large (tens of thousands of controls), so the bootstrap is
reduced to `BITERS` --- ample for a robustness check and keeps runtime sane.

```{r paths}
PATH_BATTERY  <- "../data/battery_unmatched_cs_ready.csv"
PATH_HYDROGEN <- "../data/hydrogen_unmatched_cs_ready.csv"
OUT_DIR       <- "../results/unmatched/intensity"
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

XFORMLA <- ~ log_staffCount + age + log_collab_count_2020  # same covariates as PSM
BITERS  <- 199
```

```{r load}
battery  <- load_cs(PATH_BATTERY)
hydrogen <- load_cs(PATH_HYDROGEN)
cat("battery :", n_distinct(battery$Linkedin_name), "firms\n")
cat("hydrogen:", n_distinct(hydrogen$Linkedin_name), "firms\n")
```

```{r estimate}
rows <- list(); es <- list()
for (tech in c("battery", "hydrogen")) {
  df <- if (tech == "battery") battery else hydrogen
  for (variant in c("DR", "Raw")) {
    xf <- if (variant == "DR") XFORMLA else NULL
    lab <- if (variant == "DR") "Primary" else "Selection diagnostic (raw)"
    cs <- run_cs(df, "log_collabs",
                 label = paste("unmatched", tech, variant),
                 xformla = xf, control_group = cg_for(tech),
                 weightsname = NULL, biters = BITERS, bstrap = BSTRAP)
    key <- paste(tech, variant)
    rows[[key]] <- make_att_row_std(
      agg_simple(cs, BSTRAP), tools::toTitleCase(tech), "Total collabs",
      lab, cs_out = cs, df = df, yname = "log_collabs")
    if (variant == "DR") es[[tech]] <- es_frame(cs, tools::toTitleCase(tech), "Total collabs", BSTRAP)
  }
}
att <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(att, file.path(OUT_DIR, "att_summary_intensity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
esdf <- do.call(rbind, es)
if (!is.null(esdf))
  write.csv(esdf, file.path(OUT_DIR, "event_study_intensity.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(att)
```
